title: Extension of open morphisms from a finite depth-two source
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $r:F\to L$ be finite and $p:E\to L$ affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-affine-morphism]. Assume $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{F,z}\geq2$ for every $z$ with $r(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $a:F\times_L U\to E\times_L U$ be a morphism over $U$. There is an $L$-morphism $f:F\to E$ satisfying $\iota_F f=a\iota_E$, where $\iota_F$ and $\iota_E$ are the inclusions of these open subschemes.

source.place: Tag 0EY6, converse in the proof of (2); Tags 0AUK, 0E9I and 01SA

proof.text: The finite source F is locally Noetherian. Construct the linear equivalence between the stalk of the unit module O_F and the local ring of F using preservation of colimits and the germ scalar-action formula. Depth is invariant under this equivalence, and sections of the unit module on affines are finite. Apply depth-two Hartogs restriction to this unit module. Its adjunction unit has the same underlying section functions as the open inclusion structure-sheaf map, so that map is an isomorphism.

Form the structure-algebra map induced by the open morphism. The inclusion gives an isomorphism of pushforward structure algebras; compose with its inverse. Apply the affine algebra local-map theorem and glue the compatible local maps on the inverse-image affine cover to obtain a morphism over L. Morphisms to an affine L-scheme are determined by their algebra maps, as checked on this same affine cover. Functoriality and cancellation of the inclusion algebra isomorphism give the required restriction equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0E9I and 01SA; direct unit-module Hartogs restriction followed by affine local-map gluing, avoiding finite pushforward depth transfer

theorem exists_hom_of_finite_depth_two
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {F E : Scheme.{u}} (r : F ⟶ L) (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite r] [IsAffineHom p]
    (hF : ∀ z : F, r z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk z) (F.presheaf.stalk z))
    (a : (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶ (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme)
    (ha : a ≫ p ∣_ U = r ∣_ U) :
    ∃ f : F ⟶ E, f ≫ p = r ∧ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f = a ≫ (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
